activity.notes: Galdan Boshugtu Khan was an Oirat ruler who consolidated the Zunghars into a centralized imperial polity and ruled from 1671 until his death in 1697. He styled himself khan in 1678; ATLAS records 1671-1697 as the full sovereign-rule interval at year granularity rather than treating the later title assumption as the beginning of his political rule. Under Galdan, Zunghar power expanded across Central Asia and came into major conflict with the Qing Empire.

sources.title: The Expansion of the Qing Dynasty of China and the Zunghar Mongol State — Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Asian History
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Research Encyclopedia identifies Galdan as the founder and ruler of the Zunghar state, gives his reign as 1671-1697, and describes the consolidation and expansion of Zunghar power under him.
